```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 - Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website deployment'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: AMI ID for web instances
  MasterUserPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: RDS master user password
    MinLength: 8

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  PhotoSharingVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  AttachIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Load Balancer and Security Groups
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for internet-facing load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web instances
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoSharingVPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckPort: '80'
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # EC2 Launch Template and Auto Scaling
  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300

  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # S3 Photo Bucket
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photo-bucket-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  # RDS Database
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  RDSDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'photodb-${AWS::StackName}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref MasterUserPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Headers:
              - '*'
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
          TrustedSigners: []
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 - Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website deployment'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for EC2 instances
  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Master username for RDS database

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80

      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  # Load Balancer
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetType: instance

  LoadBalancerListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener

      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:

          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  # Launch Template
  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  # Auto Scaling Group
  AutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300

  # Scaling Policy
  TargetTrackingScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref AutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS Database
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  RDSDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'photo-db-${AWS::StackName}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0.35'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: true

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Headers:
              - '*'
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
          Compress: true
          DefaultTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0
          MinTTL: 0

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudFrontDomain'

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Load balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNS'
```

```python
import sqlite3
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert one row and return its id."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list:
    """Return rows whose title or description contains term, case-insensitively."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at FROM photos WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?) ORDER BY id ASC",
        (f"%{term}%", f"%{term}%")
    )
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    result = []
    for row in rows:
        result.append({
            "id": row[0],
            "title": row[1],
            "description": row[2],
            "s3_key": row[3],
            "uploaded_at": row[4]
        })
    return result


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload one photo and return its S3 object key."""
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("Photo exceeds maximum size of 5 MiB")
    
    safe_name = _sanitize_filename(_basename(filename))
    unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    key = f"photos/{unique_id}/{safe_name}"
    
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    
    return key


def _basename(path) -> str:
    """Extract base name using forward slashes and backslashes as separators."""
    path = path.replace("\\", "/")
    return path.split("/")[-1]


def _sanitize_filename(filename) -> str:
    """Replace unsafe characters with underscores."""
    safe_chars = set("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._-")
    return "".join(c if c in safe_chars else "_" for c in filename)


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Return a presigned GET URL for the object."""
    if not isinstance(expires, int) or expires < 1 or expires > 3600:
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url("get_object", Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key}, ExpiresIn=expires)


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload the photo, then save its metadata, and return the new row id."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
    
    return photo_id
```

```python
"""Application logic for the photo-sharing website.

This module contains no AWS credentials and never constructs AWS clients;
the S3 client and the database connection are provided by the caller.
"""

import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

_ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES = {"image/jpeg", "image/png"}
_MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MiB

_SAFE_CHAR_RE = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]")


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not already exist."""
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
        """
    )
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a metadata row for a photo and return its new id."""
    uploaded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    new_id = cur.lastrowid
    if new_id is None:
        # Fallback for DB-API drivers that don't populate lastrowid.
        cur.execute("SELECT MAX(id) FROM photos")
        row = cur.fetchone()
        new_id = row[0] if row else None
    return new_id


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list:
    """Search photos whose title or description contains term (case-insensitive)."""
    pattern = "%" + str(term) + "%"
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at FROM photos "
        "WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '\\' "
        "OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '\\' "
        "ORDER BY id ASC",
        (pattern, pattern),
    )
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    results = []
    for row in rows:
        results.append(
            {
                "id": row[0],
                "title": row[1],
                "description": row[2],
                "s3_key": row[3],
                "uploaded_at": row[4],
            }
        )
    return results


def _safe_name(filename: str) -> str:
    # Strip directory components regardless of the host OS path flavour:
    # split on both forward and backward slashes, independent of the
    # platform this code happens to run on (os.path.basename would only
    # honour backslashes on Windows).
    base = str(filename)
    base = base.split("/")[-1]
    base = base.split("\\")[-1]
    return _SAFE_CHAR_RE.sub("_", base)


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a single photo, returning its S3 object key."""
    if content_type not in _ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(
            "Unsupported content type: {!r}; only image/jpeg and "
            "image/png are allowed".format(content_type)
        )
    if len(data) > _MAX_SIZE:
        raise ValueError(
            "File too large: {} bytes exceeds the maximum of {} bytes".format(
                len(data), _MAX_SIZE
            )
        )

    safe_name = _safe_name(filename)
    key = "photos/{}/{}".format(uuid.uuid4().hex, safe_name)

    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Return a presigned GET URL for the given S3 object key."""
    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires,
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and persist its metadata, rolling back S3 on failure."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    try:
        new_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
    return new_id
```

```python
    uploaded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",

    )
    conn.commit()
    new_id = cur.lastrowid
    if new_id is None:
        # Fallback for DB-API drivers that don't populate lastrowid.
        cur.execute("SELECT MAX(id) FROM photos")

    base = normalized.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    if not base:

    return _SAFE_NAME_RE.sub("_", base)

    """Validate and upload a single photo, returning its S3 key."""
    if content_type not in ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES:

    """Return a presigned GET URL for the given S3 object."""
    if not isinstance(expires, int) or isinstance(expires, bool) or not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be an integer between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")

    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires,
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and persist its metadata, rolling back the upload on failure."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)

    try:
        new_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
```

```python
    conn.execute("""

            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a photo metadata row and return its id."""
    timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, timestamp)
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitively."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at
        FROM photos
        WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?)
        ORDER BY id ASC
        """,
        (f"%{term}%", f"%{term}%")
    )
    columns = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:

    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):

    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:

    base_name = filename.replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1]

    key = f"photos/{unique_id}/{safe_name}"

    return key

    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):

    )

    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 - Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website deployment'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: AMI ID for web server instances
  
  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    Description: Master username for RDS database
  
  DBMasterPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 8
    Description: Master password for RDS database

Resources:
  # VPC and Network Infrastructure
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NATGateway'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable'

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security Groups
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ALB-SG'

  WebInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Web-SG'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DB-SG'

  # Application Load Balancer
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ALB'

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TG'

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # IAM Role and Instance Profile
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Role'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebInstance'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  # Auto Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # S3 Bucket
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PhotoBucket'

  # RDS Database
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DBSubnetGroup'

  RDSDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DBMasterPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS'

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            Id: ALBOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: ALBOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
```

```python
"""Application logic for the photo-sharing website.

This module contains no AWS credentials and never constructs AWS clients;
the S3 client and the database connection are provided by the caller.
"""

import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

_ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES = {"image/jpeg", "image/png"}
_MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MiB

_SAFE_CHAR_RE = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]")


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not already exist."""
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
        """
    )
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a metadata row for a photo and return its new id."""
    uploaded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list:
    """Search photos whose title or description contains term (case-insensitive)."""
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at FROM photos "
        "ORDER BY id ASC"
    )
    rows = cur.fetchall()

    needle = ("" if term is None else str(term)).lower()
    results = []
    for row in rows:
        row_id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at = row[0], row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4]
        title_text = title or ""
        description_text = description or ""
        if needle in title_text.lower() or needle in description_text.lower():
            results.append(
                {
                    "id": row_id,
                    "title": title,
                    "description": description,
                    "s3_key": s3_key,
                    "uploaded_at": uploaded_at,
                }
            )
    return results


def _safe_name(filename: str) -> str:
    # Remove directory components regardless of which separator style
    # (POSIX '/' or Windows '\\') was used in the supplied filename.
    normalized = filename.replace("\\", "/")
    base = normalized.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    return _SAFE_CHAR_RE.sub("_", base)


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a single photo, returning its S3 object key."""
    if content_type not in _ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(
            "Unsupported content type: {!r}; only image/jpeg and "
            "image/png are allowed".format(content_type)
        )
    if len(data) > _MAX_SIZE:
        raise ValueError(
            "File too large: {} bytes exceeds the maximum of {} bytes".format(
                len(data), _MAX_SIZE
            )
        )

    safe_name = _safe_name(filename)
    key = "photos/{}/{}".format(uuid.uuid4().hex, safe_name)

    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Return a presigned GET URL for the given S3 object key."""
    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires,
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and persist its metadata, rolling back S3 on failure."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    try:
        new_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
    return new_id
```

```python
import re
import uuid

_ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES = {"image/jpeg", "image/png"}
_MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MiB

_SAFE_CHAR_RE = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]")

# Escape character used for LIKE patterns, and the characters that need
# escaping within a LIKE pattern (the escape character itself must be
# escaped first).
_LIKE_ESCAPE_CHAR = "\\"
_LIKE_SPECIALS = (_LIKE_ESCAPE_CHAR, "%", "_")


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not already exist."""
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
        """
    )
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a metadata row for a photo and return its new id."""
    uploaded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    new_id = cur.lastrowid
    if new_id is None:
        # Fallback for DB-API drivers that don't populate lastrowid.
        cur.execute("SELECT MAX(id) FROM photos")
        row = cur.fetchone()
        new_id = row[0] if row else None
    return new_id


def _escape_like_term(term: str) -> str:
    """Escape LIKE metacharacters so term is matched as a literal substring."""
    escaped = term
    for ch in _LIKE_SPECIALS:
        escaped = escaped.replace(ch, _LIKE_ESCAPE_CHAR + ch)
    return escaped


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list:
    """Search photos whose title or description contains term (case-insensitive).

    The term is treated as a literal substring: any characters that are
    special to SQL LIKE (%, _, and the escape character itself) are escaped
    so that, e.g., searching for "50%" only matches a literal "50%" rather
    than acting as a wildcard.
    """
    pattern = "%" + _escape_like_term(str(term)) + "%"
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at FROM photos "
        "WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '\\' "
        "OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '\\' "
        "ORDER BY id ASC",
        (pattern, pattern),
    )
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    results = []
    for row in rows:
        results.append(
            {
                "id": row[0],
                "title": row[1],
                "description": row[2],
                "s3_key": row[3],
                "uploaded_at": row[4],
            }
        )
    return results


def _safe_name(filename: str) -> str:
    base = os.path.basename(filename)
    base = base.replace("\\", "/")
    base = os.path.basename(base)
    return _SAFE_CHAR_RE.sub("_", base)


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a single photo, returning its S3 object key."""
    if content_type not in _ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(
            "Unsupported content type: {!r}; only image/jpeg and "
            "image/png are allowed".format(content_type)
        )
    if len(data) > _MAX_SIZE:
        raise ValueError(
            "File too large: {} bytes exceeds the maximum of {} bytes".format(
                len(data), _MAX_SIZE
            )
        )

    safe_name = _safe_name(filename)
    key = "photos/{}/{}".format(uuid.uuid4().hex, safe_name)

    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Return a presigned GET URL for the given S3 object key."""
    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires,
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and persist its metadata, rolling back S3 on failure."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
```
